business_snapshot.title: Business snapshot
business_snapshot.content: The company provides end-to-end business solutions and IT services, including software development and maintenance, consulting, package implementation, and business process management [1, 2, 8]. Its main business segments are organized by client industries such as Financial Services and Insurance, Manufacturing, Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods and Logistics, Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services, Communication, Telecom OEM and Media, Hi-Tech, and Life Sciences and Healthcare [3, 7]. The company derives its revenue primarily from software services alongside products and platforms [10].

balance_sheet.title: Balance sheet
balance_sheet.content: Infosys maintains a strong balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.0, as total debt represents only lease liabilities [1]. The company has no outstanding borrowings and believes its working capital is sufficient to meet current requirements [7]. As of March 31, 2026, the company recorded a current ratio of 2.0 and a net capital turnover ratio of 3.6 [1, 2].
